instruction: Cinematic medium shot of a boxing training session inside a dimly lit gym with a boxing ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange sports top (R1) stands facing right, holding up a red focus mitt with her right hand to block a punch. On the right, the Asian woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands facing left, throwing a straight left punch with her black boxing glove directly into the raised mitt. The trainer (R1) maintains a focused expression, absorbing the impact, while the boxer (R2) concentrates intensely on her target. The background features black punching bags and red ring ropes under cool overhead lights, creating a moody, athletic atmosphere.
elements: R1 holds up a red focus mitt to block and absorb R2's punch
R2 throws a straight left punch into the mitt held by R1
R1 is the trainer using the mitt as the target while R2 is the boxer striking it
A red focus mitt is used as the contact target
R2 wears a black boxing glove while punching
The session takes place in a dimly lit gym with a boxing ring
